hooks.command: g='git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--(git-dir|work-tree|namespace|config-env))[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | grep -E "$g"'push([[:space:]]|$)' | grep -Eq -e '(^|[[:space:]])(-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*|--force|--force-with-lease|--force-if-includes)([=[:space:]]|$)' -e '[[:space:]][+][^[:space:]]' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git push の force 系オプションは禁止。リモートを巻き戻すおそれがあるため、必要なら人が手で実行する。"}}'; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+commit' || exit 0; command -v git-secrets >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git secrets --scan --cached >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"staged の内容が git-secrets のパターンに一致した。回避せずに止まり、git secrets --scan --cached の結果をユーザーに報告する。.gitallowed は自分で編集しない。"}}'; exit 0

g='git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--(git-dir|work-tree|namespace|config-env))[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | while IFS= read -r l; do m() { printf '%s' " $l" | grep -Eq -e "$1"; }; { m "$g"'reset([[:space:]]|$).*--hard' || m "$g"'switch(.*[[:space:]])?(-f|--force|--discard-changes)([[:space:]]|$)' || m "$g"'clean(.*[[:space:]])?(--force|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)' || { m "$g"'restore([[:space:]]|$)' && { ! m '[[:space:]](--staged|-[a-zA-Z]*S[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)' || m '[[:space:]](--worktree|-[a-zA-Z]*W[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)'; }; } || m "$g"'rm([[:space:]].*)?[[:space:]](--force|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)'; } && { echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"未コミットの変更を捨てる操作。"}}'; break; }; done; exit 0

g='git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--(git-dir|work-tree|namespace|config-env))[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | while IFS= read -r l; do printf '%s' " $l" | grep -Eq "$g"'push([[:space:]]|$)' || continue; if printf '%s' "$l" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+origin[[:space:]]+HEAD[[:space:]]*(2>)?[[:space:]]*$'; then case $(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD) in ''|main|master|develop) ;; *) continue ;; esac; fi; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"外へ出す push。確認なしで通すのは、main・master・develop 以外のブランチからの git push origin HEAD だけ。"}}'; break; done; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | while IFS= read -r l; do l=" $l"; printf '%s' "$l" | grep -Eq '[[:space:]]gh[[:space:]]+api([[:space:]]|$)' || continue; m=$(printf '%s' "$l" | grep -Eo '[[:space:]](-X|--method)(=|[[:space:]]*)[A-Za-z]+' | sed -nE '$s/.*(-X|--method)(=|[[:space:]]*)//p' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'); if [ -n "$m" ]; then [ "$m" = GET ] && continue; else printf '%s' "$l" | grep -Eq '[[:space:]](-[fF]|--field|--raw-field|--input)' || continue; fi; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"GitHub に書き込む gh api。-X GET 以外のメソッドか、-X GET なしの -f・-F・--input は POST になる。"}}'; break; done; exit 0
